title: How many whole units are there in four thirds and seven thirds?
description: Four thirds and seven thirds are each split into groups of three thirds that make whole units. The board counts the groups, keeps the third that is left and checks by putting the pieces back together.
teaching_notes: One idea: each group of three thirds is one whole unit. Watch for students who count the thirds as whole units.

source: Figure it Out Q2 (section 7.5, first block), Math Talk
video_script.why: A learner finds the whole units in fractions greater than one by grouping their thirds in threes.
video_script.substitution: the book's own fractions four thirds and seven thirds
video_script.anchor: four and seven third-unit bars in two rows
video_script.payoff_line: Four thirds has one whole unit, and seven thirds has two whole units

final_answer.value: 4/3 has 1 whole unit (4/3 = 1 + 1/3); 7/3 has 2 whole units (7/3 = 2 + 1/3)
final_answer.spoken: four thirds has one whole unit and seven thirds has two whole units

video_script.fraction_reading: one third, three thirds, four thirds, six thirds, seven thirds
maths_rules: 7/3 = 6/3 + 1/3, and 6 thirds make 2 wholes, so 2 whole units
check: 3 thirds + 1 third = 4 thirds and 6 thirds + 1 third = 7 thirds
video_script.design: Two rows of third bars, four in the first and seven in the second. Each row is grouped in threes.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a row of four third-unit bars and a row of seven third-unit bars, labelled 4/3 and 7/3

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears
marks.rows: a row of four third bars and a row of seven third bars appear
marks.ask: the fractions four thirds and seven thirds are written beside the rows

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book, and it is about thirds.
<bookmark mark='rows'/>One row has four third bars, and the other row has seven.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How many whole units are there in four thirds and in seven thirds?

beats.on_screen: the two rows stay; the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: a whole unit bar beside three third bars of the same total length

marks.whole: a whole unit bar appears beside three third bars of the same length

narration: <bookmark mark='whole'/>Three thirds put together are the same length as one whole unit.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the fractions that we have to look at are four thirds and seven thirds.

beats.on_screen: To find: how many whole units are in 4/3 and in 7/3
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find how many whole units are in each of them.

marks.three: three third bars join into one whole unit bar

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step one, we use the same way as the example in your book. Three thirds make one whole.

marks.four: four thirds is split into three thirds and one third
marks.one: the three thirds join into one whole bar

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Step two, four thirds is three thirds and one more third.
<bookmark mark='one'/>Three thirds make one whole, so four thirds has one whole unit.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: 7/3 = 6/3 + 1/3; 6 thirds = 2 groups of 3 thirds = 2 wholes

marks.seven: seven thirds is split into six thirds and one third
marks.two: the six thirds join in groups of three into two whole bars

narration: <bookmark mark='seven'/>Step three, seven thirds is six thirds and one more third.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Six thirds make two groups of three thirds, so seven thirds has two whole units.

beats.on_screen: Check: 3 thirds + 1 third = 4 thirds, and 6 thirds + 1 third = 7 thirds

marks.check: each whole count and its left over third are put back together

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, put the pieces back together. Three thirds and one third make four thirds. Six thirds and one third make seven thirds.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 4/3 has 1 whole unit (4/3 = 1 + 1/3); 7/3 has 2 whole units (7/3 = 2 + 1/3)
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Four thirds has one whole unit, and seven thirds has two whole units.
